jump verb

also leap, jumping, jump down, jump out, jump across, spring up, high jump, long jump

classical

Traupman 335

saliō, salīre, saluī, saltum

verb, fourth conjugation

jump or leap

Other words

  • saltus, saltūs m. — a jump or leap

    noun, fourth declension · classical · Traupman 328

  • exsiliō, exsilīre — jump out or spring up

    verb, fourth conjugation · also used · classical

  • dēsiliō, dēsilīre — jump down

    verb, fourth conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 335

  • trānsiliō, trānsilīre — jump across

    verb, fourth conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 289
